limitations: This is a read of one existing artifact, not a product rerun.
The source nominal remains one passed and three timed out scenarios.
SCENARIO preserves original runtime JSON metadata; RESULT preserves retained HTML detail separately.
Step durations are inclusive and may overlap. Parent/child durations must not be added.
Each transport attachment has its own elapsedMs origin; cross-attachment elapsedMs values are not directly comparable.
The selected tree is slow >=1000ms, final45 steps, all waits/errors and their ancestors; flatCount/selected/omitted and index/parent disclose selection.
No trace, Office file, preserved review body, DOM snapshot, header, cookie, token, signed URL or C05 payload was extracted.
No request/response transport from the C05 click/preflight period is retained in these selected attachments. A pending create waiter does not prove whether its request was sent.
A download response200 followed by browser ERR_ABORTED does not override the original completed export assertions.
The connection-refused events appear at the original deadline/teardown and do not prove a primary server crash.
